definitions.explanation: A very deep, dark shade of blue, darker than ordinary navy. Commonly used for suits, school uniforms, and formal clothing.

examples.japanese: {濃紺|のうこん}のスーツを{着|き}ている。
examples.english: He is wearing a dark navy suit.

examples.japanese: {制服|せいふく}は{濃紺|のうこん}のブレザーだ。
examples.english: The school uniform is a dark navy blazer.

examples.japanese: {濃紺|のうこん}は{黒|くろ}に{近|ちか}いが、{光|ひかり}に{当|あ}たると{青|あお}みが{分|わ}かる。
examples.english: Dark navy is close to black, but you can see its blue tint in the light.

notes:
USAGE:
{濃紺|のうこん} is composed of {濃|のう} (dark/rich in color) and {紺|こん} (navy blue). It is commonly used for describing clothing, especially formal or professional attire.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {濃紺|のうこん}のスーツ (a dark navy suit)
- {濃紺|のうこん}のネクタイ (a dark navy tie)
- {濃紺|のうこん}に{近|ちか}い (close to dark navy)

RELATED COLORS:
- {紺|こん} (navy blue — standard shade)
- {藍色|あいいろ} (indigo — the traditional dye color)
- ネイビー (navy — the loanword)
